models_evaluated: RAG framework for large language models with medical knowledge graph

links.outcome: ROUGE-L of RAG-grounded question answering versus vanilla LLMs
links.effect: RAG framework with knowledge graph and ranking raised ROUGE-L by 18% over vanilla models; physician-rated accuracy 3.90/5 and completeness 3.31/5.
links.quote: In the question-answering task, the RAG framework raised the ROUGE-L score by 18% over the vanilla models.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning domain-specific language models for medical text generation tasks
Knowledge-graph-based retrieval with ranking to improve answer reliability

screen.reason: The study evaluates a generative NLP toolkit (Ascle) for clinical text generation tasks, including physician validation and testing whether adding a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework with a medical knowledge graph improves output quality over vanilla LLMs.
